subject: economics
summary: Most economics cards ask a clear, short question in text and the scheme is broken into tickable points with marks, which reads well on both phone and desktop. The main fault is the attachment: every card attaches whole exam pages, and in 6 of 12 sampled cards the reader opens on a DIFFERENT question (e.g. Q7 when the card is Q8(c)), with the card's own part off-screen further down; the rest open on sibling parts. Fill-in-the-blank and bullet-list questions are flattened into a run-on sentence (card 6 loses its blanks entirely). 'State and explain' schemes glue the heading and its explanation together with no separator, and slashes from the examiner's alternatives are left raw. Where the question is shown as a picture (cards 11, 12) the text is tiny on a phone, and the official answer picture appears in the question column rather than with the scheme.

issues.title: Attached page opens on a different question
issues.detail: The 'Official question page' attaches the whole printed page uncropped. The reader opens at the top of the page, which shows other questions in full before the card's own: card 2 (Q8(c)(i)) shows all of Q7 and Q8(a); card 3 (Q10) shows Q9 parts (i) and (ii) with Q10 only starting at the bottom edge; card 5 (Q6(ii)) shows all of Q5; card 6 (Q9) shows Q8 and its circular-flow diagram, Q9 not visible; card 7 (Q7(b)(ii)) shows all of Q6 and Q7(a); card 11 (Q6) shows Q4 and Q5, Q6 not visible. A student tapping the attachment sees the wrong question first and has to scroll to find theirs.
issues.suggested_fix: Crop the attachment to the card's own question region (or at minimum scroll/anchor the reader to it and grey out the rest). For plain text questions with no figure or table (cards 2, 3, 5, 7, 10) drop the attachment altogether: it adds nothing the text does not already say.

issues.title: Attached page shows sibling parts and multi-page spreads
issues.detail: Where the page is the right question, it still shows every other part. Card 1 (Q14(c)(i), elasticity) opens page 1 of 3 on the Q14 inflation graph and part (a)(i), nothing to do with elasticity; the PED part is two pages on. Card 12 opens page 1 of 4 on Q14(a)(i)-(ii). Cards 4, 8, 9, 10 show parts (a)/(b)/(c) of the same question around the target.
issues.suggested_fix: Attach only the page (and region) that holds this part; for a multi-page question open on the page the part is on, not page 1.

issues.title: Fill-in-the-blank question flattened, blanks lost
issues.detail: Card 6 runs the word bank and the gapped sentence together with no blanks: 'Utility Price Quantity Scarce resources Opportunity Cost Economic goods require the use of to produce them and so their use has an . Such goods command a in the marketplace.' It reads as broken English and the five terms are not distinguishable from the sentence.
issues.suggested_fix: Show the five terms as a row of chips or a bulleted list, then the sentence on its own line with visible blanks (____). Or show the official crop as cards 11/12 do.

issues.title: Bullets and sub-parts run into one paragraph
issues.detail: Card 4 prints the two scenario bullets inline ('...due to the following: • an unexpected heavy rainfall...; • breakdown of the main supply truck...') and then (i), (ii), (iii) as one long sentence in the large serif question style. The orange underline covers only an arbitrary middle slice of it. Card 5 keeps the paper's form text 'Yes / No. Place a circle around your choice' and then appends 'Justify the choice: YES.' which reads oddly.
issues.suggested_fix: Render bullets as a real list and (i)/(ii)/(iii) each on its own line. For the split yes/no card, rewrite the ask plainly: 'Assume you answered YES. Outline two reasons.'

issues.title: Question refers to formatting or position that is not there
issues.detail: Card 10 asks 'Explain each of the underlined taxes' but nothing is underlined in the stem (VAT, carbon taxes, household charge were underlined on the paper). Card 9 says 'The diagram above' twice while the diagram is below the text. Card 1 prints the value as '= - 0.5' with a stray space, wrapping the minus sign away from the number on the phone.
issues.suggested_fix: Underline or bold the three taxes in the stem; put the figure above the question text or change the wording to 'the diagram below'; print '-0.5' unbroken.

issues.title: Scheme heading and explanation glued together, raw slashes
issues.detail: In 'state and explain' schemes each option is the heading followed straight by its explanation with no colon, bold or line break: 'Sustainable government finances / reduce borrowing The government must try to...', 'Availability of skilled workforce A business will require...', 'Membership of EU As Ireland is a member...'. Examiner slashes are left in ('market/A business which requires', 'Boost exports / improve competitiveness / attracting investment / upskill the workforce By taking steps'). Card 4 has 'so the demand will increase or — the D/C will shift to the right'. Card 5 does this correctly with a colon after the heading.
issues.suggested_fix: Bold the factor name and put the explanation on the next line (or at least add a colon, as card 5 does). Turn 'A / B' alternatives into 'A or B'.

issues.title: Mark rule stated two or three times, filler captions
issues.detail: Card 7 states the rule three ways in one box: 'Any 2 of these — 8 marks each', 'Two factors, 8 marks each (4 + 4)' and 'Answer any 2 of these 9 — 8 marks each'. Card 9 repeats the grey caption 'A point the scheme lists.' above four of its five points. Card 3 puts the whole 12-mark rule inside the 'One private benefit' box and uses one checkbox for three alternative answers, floating beside the middle one.
issues.suggested_fix: State the mark rule once at the top of the group; remove the repeated filler caption; list alternatives as bullets under one clearly labelled tick.

issues.title: Question shown only as a small picture on the phone; answer picture sits in the question area
issues.detail: Cards 11 and 12 show the question only as a crop of the paper, with no text version. On the 390px phone the crop text is roughly half the size of the app's body text (card 12's cost table and the '(ii) Using the figures...' line are barely readable without tapping Enlarge). After the reveal the official answer picture (card 11 answer table, card 12 the dark 'Cost of Production' graph captioned 'Axes 4') is inserted under the question, above 'Your answer', not in the scheme section, so on the phone it is a long way from the tick list it belongs to. Card 12's crop also includes sibling part (i) and its calculation boxes, and a stray vertical rule down the right of the graph.
issues.suggested_fix: Give the question as text too (the manifest already has it) and keep the crop for the table only; show the answer image inside the scheme section headed 'Official answer'; crop card 12 to the table plus part (ii).

good_examples.why: Short clear question, clean chart crop limited to the graph, one-line scheme point with marks.
Three definitions, each a labelled tick with 5 marks; scheme answers the question exactly and fits one phone screen.
Diagram crop is tight and legible and the scheme points refer directly to PE, PMax and the quantities on it.
